name: onomeo
description: Chat front-end with an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and a free-model call quota.
overview: onomeo runs a chat site and exposes the same models through https://onomeo.com/v1, OpenAI-compatible. Free models cost nothing and are limited by call quotas per window — the API returns account_quota (403) once your window is spent and network_quota or site_busy (429) when the shared pool is under load — while paid models such as Claude and GPT need a top-up. A key comes from the site login, and the documented default model is gemma-4-31b.
free_access: Free models cost nothing, no top-up
Call quotas per window, shared across the free pool
Paid models only if you add balance
notes: No published number for the free-call window; the error body states what would cover a request.

models.name: Gemma 4 31B
models.rate_limits: Free-model call quota per window; 403 account_quota when spent
